thread.title: Dow Jones, Apple, Tesla Fall On China Trade War Fears| Investor's Business Daily

author: ED CARSON
title: Dow Jones, Apple, Tesla Fall On China Trade War Fears| Investor's Business Daily
text:
The Dow Jones fell modestly Tuesday morning, along with the S&P 500 index and Nasdaq composite. President Donald Trump late Monday signaled he's ready to escalate the China trade war by raising and expanding China tariffs, including on Apple ( AAPL ) iPhones. Apple stock fell early. Tesla stock fell on its own China woes. United Technologies ( UTX ), Spirit Airlines ( SAVE ) and IBD 50 stock Canada Goose ( GOOS ) also were moving in Tuesday's stock market .
X Dow Jones Today The Dow Jones fell 0.85%, the S&P 500 index 0.5% and the Nasdaq 0.65%. It's the fourth day of a stock market rally attempt for the Nasdaq composite, which means it could have a follow-through day at any time. The Dow Jones and S&P 500 index rally attempts are on day two.
Trump also said he was ready to go ahead with hiking the tariff rate on $200 billion worth of Chinese goods to 25% from 10%, and slapping duties on all remaining Chinese imports. That includes a 10% tariff on Apple iPhones imported from China. The threat to escalate the China trade war comes days ahead of a key meeting Saturday between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping.
The latest Trump trade war threat could be just tough talk before the Trump-Xi meeting. If there's a deal or truce for that meeting, Wall Street may rally. But stocks could react poorly if the meeting ends with more U.S.-China trade war threats.

Please contact customer service CLOSE Apple Stock, China Trade War Apple fell 1.7% soon after the open in Tuesday's stock market trading . President Trump said late Monday he could impose a 10% tariff on Apple iPhones. Trump also said he was ready to go ahead with hiking the tariff rate on $200 billion worth of Chinese goods to 25% from 10%, and slapping duties on all remaining Chinese imports.
Apple stock is trading near seven-month lows. It's also at risk of losing its market cap crown to fellow Dow Jones stock Microsoft ( MSFT ). Microsoft stock, down 0.7% early Tuesday, has held up well this month as Apple stock has crashed.
Tesla Stock Tesla stock sank 1.25% early Tuesday.
Sales in China fell 70% in October vs. a year earlier to just 211 Tesla electric vehicles, according to a Chinese trade body. China hiked its tariff on imported U.S. cars to 40% in retaliation for Trump tariffs. On the Q3 Tesla earnings call, CEO Elon Musk complained about the U.S.-China trade war impact on sales in the world's biggest market for autos and electric vehicles.
Tesla stock shot up 6.2% on Monday, bouncing back from a four-day slide. Shares have formed a new handle in a cup base , giving it a 366.85 buy point.
United Technologies Stock United Technologies stock erased early gains and fell 5.6% on a plan to split the company into three parts. The Dow Jones conglomerate will keep its aerospace businesses, which expanded with its just-closed acquisition of Rockwell Collins. It'll spin off its Otis elevators business and its Carrier unit that makes air conditioners and heating systems.
Spirit Airlines Stock Spirit Airlines stock shot up 20% early after the low-fare, high-fee carrier forecast revenue per available seat to soar 11% in Q4. That's nearly double its prior 6% estimate. Spirit Airlines stock vaulted to a three-year high.
Canada Goose Stock The seller of $1,000 parkas announced plans to sell 10 million shares. That sent Canada Goose stock fell 5.2% soon after the open. Canada Goose stock vaulted to record high Nov. 14 on blowout earnings and has been consolidating close to those levels since then.
